main_body: two-story half-timbered tavern building with tiled roof
top_band: orange-brown tiled roof slope from row 0 to row 43
evidence: The building clearly shows a large foreshortened roof slope (rows 0-43) with a chimney showing its top opening (rows 8-11), sitting above the vertical front facade (rows 44-95) with an eave shadow under the roof (rows 44-45) and recessed door/windows.

style.evidence: While the roof tiles have 4-5 steps, the roof border uses a harsh near-black outline (rows 0-42 left/right edges), the plaster wall has very faint low-contrast noise that reads almost flat compared to the reference's crisp plaster speckle and timber framing, and the chimney is a simple flat grey box compared to the richly textured brick chimney on the reference.
